instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.html or global layout to include dir='rtl' for Arabic-first layout.
Add 'Cairo' font from Google Fonts and apply it in tailwind config.
Create 3 distinct user flows/views based on role: Customer, Barber, Admin.
Implement Customer Map view using Leaflet. Include a FAB for quick booking actions.
Implement Barber Wallet that calculates earnings minus 1000 IQD per job.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards against dark backgrounds.
Include the required data-testid attributes for testing.
